[[File:Scott Atkins 2020 Resource of the Year.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Scott Atkins with his 2020 Resource of the Year award.]]
'''Scott Atkins''' (forums handle '''scottrick49''') finished second in [[2022 Retro League Event 1]]<ref name="p1367981" /> and is a [[Players Committee]] volunteer. He develops and administers the Comlink Android app, in the infrastructure and apps group under the [[Rules Advocate]] [[Greg Zinn]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref> See [[Players Committee organization]].
